regime_context: US thematic leadership remains concentrated in AI Infrastructure with Energy Complex closing as challenger; breadth of rotation is narrowing (22/49 eligible, 45%) but no single narrative dominates. The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history, so eligible (trend-healthy) themes dominate the upper ranks, while the detector's momentum rank itself is a focus lens only and unscheduled macro-surprise share is high (0.75), arguing for humility.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the Energy Complex (XLE proxy) actually completes a confirmed leadership handoff from AI Infrastructure: the margin is 0.185 and narrowing. The watch retires if the margin widens back past ~0.35 in favor of AI Infrastructure or if energy's momentum reverses. This is a handoff observation, not a prediction.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Highest eligible score among non-AI themes with the strongest breadth (0.636) and no crowding flag (0.93 z), ranking 2nd and narrowing the gap to AI Infrastructure. The trend-gate leg is the only validated edge here: eligibility means the absolute trend is intact, which raises staying power relative to ineligible energy-adjacent names like Power & Grid or Uranium.

absolute trend gate validated as drawdown control (gate_helps: true)

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Trend-healthy (hurst 'trend', eligible) but crowding_z 1.61 is the only flagged-crowded theme in the top of the list, and the guardrails explicitly say crowding is a size-down caution, not a trigger. No new trend-gate or breadth signal justifies adding; it is a hold-steady, not an overweight.
evidence: guardrails: crowding downsizes, never a buy
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is a durable secular spending theme with trend health; crowding flags in this detector have no forward return edge and may simply reflect sustained institutional demand.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks below its own 50-day average while SPY holds above it before the check-by date

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Highest durability_bar in the entire list (0.81) and broadest breadth (0.778) but crowded (1.11) and score is barely positive (-0.08). The discipline leg says trend is intact; the crowding leg says do not add. Avoid chasing a crowded, low-momentum defensive.
theses.dissent: In a high unscheduled-surprise macro regime (0.75), defensive managed care with deep trend health could be exactly the shake-out shelter the validated gate is designed to keep.

falsifier.text: XLV's managed-care constituents underperform the S&P 500 by more than 3% while remaining eligible before the check-by date
